messages:
Sasha P.: quick heads-up — kicking off AWS GovCloud marketplace onboarding for the DeptX proof-of-concept. Need to align on SKU surface, EULA/legal terms, KMS/retention, and sandbox access. @Priya N., @Miguel R., @Tom K., @Ingrid L. can you confirm availability for a 30m sync tomorrow?
Priya N.: I can take the EULA + export-control check. please drop any contract draft and required compliance clauses.
Miguel R.: will draft SKU + trial flow. question: are we doing pay-as-you-go or seat-based trial for Gov customers? affects SKU naming.
Tom K.: need the GovCloud account IDs and any network egress rules. also confirm whether the marketplace listing needs an AMI or just API endpoint references.
Ingrid L.: KMS needs: key in GovCloud region, CMK policy template, and retention TTLs. if customer wants HSM-backed keys we need procurement lead time.
Sasha P.: good. high-level plan: 1) legal review (Priya) 2) SKU + pricing plan (Miguel) 3) infra hookups & sandbox creds (Tom) 4) KMS policy + security checklist (Ingrid) 5) marketplace packaging + assets (marketing/product)
Priya N.: uploading contract redline to drive: https://drive.internal/repo/gov-deptx-contract (please keep internal). need vendor-attestation form from them before final EULA.
Miguel R.: I'll propose SKU names: redwood-gov-api, redwood-gov-dedicated, redwood-gov-embed-trial. will post a short table in this thread later.
Tom K.: tagging infra-ops for GovCloud account numbers. infra-ops: can you DM me org and sandbox account ids? also, if we need an AMI, build runbooks ready.
infra-ops (via legal-bot): Received request. We're provisioning sandbox account; ETA 48h.
Ingrid L.: security note — marketplace L5 requires vulnerability attestation and signed SBOM. Can we get build pipeline to emit SBOM for the Gov AMI?
Miguel R.: yes, build can emit SBOM — will coordinate with eng-ml and devex.
Sasha P.: action items (short):
- Priya: EULA redline + export checklist (due EOD Wed)
- Miguel: SKU table + pricing recommendation (due EOD Thu)
- Tom: sandbox account + AMI decision (update in 48h)
- Ingrid: KMS policy template + SBOM gating checklist (due Fri)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack and add any blockers. Planning to run a 30m sync at 11am PT tomorrow if most can make it.
Priya N.: acked :thumbsup:
Miguel R.: acked :v:
Tom K.: acked. if AMI required I'll need a short window for build testing.
Ingrid L.: acked. I'll attach policy snippets after lunch.
Sasha P.: thanks team — I'll create a short calendar invite and include the doc links.
legal-bot: Reminder — store sensitive docs in secure drive folder with restricted access.
Sasha P.: noted. linking secure folder here: https://secure.internal/gov-deptx-onboard (internal only)
Miguel R.: adding a note — pricing decision will affect entitlements mapping for marketplace API. we should lock that before packaging.
Priya N.: if vendor attestation delays, we can do conditional listing copy and add compliance footnote. will flag early if needed.
Tom K.: infra-ops update (follow-up): sandbox provisioned, sent DM with IDs.
Ingrid L.: posted KMS policy template: https://secure.internal/kmspolicies/gov-template-v1 (draft)
Sasha P.: all great. see you all at 11am PT tomorrow. if anything urgent ping me in DMs. :rocket:
